original_idea: 我想研究利用机器学习或深度学习模型，基于公开 ICU 临床数据预测患者发生急性肾损伤的风险。请分析目前是否已经有类似研究、已有研究主要采用哪些方法、可能存在什么研究差异，以及这个想法在数据、方法、算力和验证方面是否具有可行性。

task: 预测患者发生急性肾损伤的风险

idea_comparisons.idea_quote: 公开 ICU 临床数据
idea_comparisons.reason: 综述指出公共ICU数据集被广泛使用，与用户使用公开ICU临床数据的设想一致。

evidence.quote: Public ICU datasets were widely used.

idea_comparisons.idea_quote: 机器学习或深度学习模型
idea_comparisons.reason: 综述总结了LR、RF、XGBoost、SVM等常用模型，与用户机器学习/深度学习建模设想重叠。

evidence.quote: Across the 47 included studies, models including LR, RF, XGBoost, and SVM were the most commonly used.

idea_comparisons.idea_quote: 预测患者发生急性肾损伤的风险
idea_comparisons.reason: 研究以AKI风险预测性能为结局，与用户关注的风险预测结果一致。

evidence.quote: While dC-aKi demonstrated strong performance in the development and one external cohort, performance varied substantially across institutions-most notably in eiCu-CRd, where coarser data granularity limited discrimination.

claims.text: 可供进一步调查的方向：模型在不同机构间性能差异明显，数据粒度与本地记录实践可能影响可迁移性，用户研究需考虑跨机构泛化。

evidence.quote: While dC-aKi demonstrated strong performance in the development and one external cohort, performance varied substantially across institutions-most notably in eiCu-CRd, where coarser data granularity limited discrimination.

claims.verification_needed: 需核实目标数据集间数据粒度与记录规范差异。

claims.text: 多数模型尚未进入临床整合，用户研究若定位为方法学探索，可关注可解释性与临床可用性而非部署。；推理：综述指出多数模型远离临床整合，同时认为实时动态模型有助于早期识别，提示研究价值与方法学定位需区分。；范围：ICU AKI预测模型的临床转化现状

evidence.quote: Despite notable progress in predictive modeling for AKI in ICU settings, most models remain far from clinical integration.
The real-time dynamic AKI prediction models help identify high-risk patients early and facilitate timely clinical interventions.

claims.text: 可行性（methods；conditional）：已有研究常用LR、RF、XGBoost、SVM等模型，方法上有可复现基线；但用户具体模型适配与基线复现仍需验证。；下一步核查：在选定数据集上复现一个已报道的基线模型并记录预处理与评估流程。

evidence.quote: Across the 47 included studies, models including LR, RF, XGBoost, and SVM were the most commonly used.
